C1498.title: CTF Challenge on Long-Range Attacks in Proof-of-Stake Blockchains
C1498.summary: In September 2025, the GitHub project miniblockchain2 published a Proof-of-Stake long-range attack CTF. Its chain lacks finality and checkpointing, while validator selection relies on manipulable timestamps and weak randomness. Participants must build a longer alternative history from the genesis block, transfer the treasure, and obtain the flag; the repository also provides an example exploit and solution guide.
